architecture_display: BiLSTM encoder + LSTM decoder (supplied checkpoint has no attention layer)
known_limitations: The supplied checkpoint does not contain an attention layer.
The original source input retained target docstrings, creating leakage risk.
Default Keras tokenizer filters removed many programming operators.
Reported accuracy was not masked and includes padding positions.
Only 4,000 examples and five epochs were used.
Greedy outputs are often repetitive and BLEU on 100 examples was zero.
upgrade_path: Run scripts/train_model.py to produce a true Bahdanau-attention checkpoint, encoder_model.keras, decoder_model.keras, and updated metadata.
